title: Goods Triple Sort
seo_title: Goods Triple Sort — Play Free Goods & Shelf Sorting Game Online
meta_desc: Play Goods Triple Sort free online. Drag milk, cola and cakes onto shelves and match three identical items to clear them in this goods sorting puzzle.
desc: Goods Triple Sort turns a cluttered store into a tidy one. Drag everyday products between shelves and line up three identical items to clear them off the board. Shelf space is tight, so every drag needs a reason.
howto: Tap or click a product to select it.
Drag it to another shelf with matching items or free space.
Line up three identical products to clear them from the shelf.
Keep at least one shelf slot open for reorganizing.
Clear every shelf to finish the level.

controls.action: drag and drop products between shelves

tips: Build pairs early so a third matching item clears instantly.
Never fill your last empty slot without an immediate match.
Clear the most crowded shelf first to unlock breathing room.
